# agentest (agentest-ai) — deterministic OpenTelemetry evals for AI agents

> agentest (agentest-ai on PyPI) is an open-source, offline, deterministic evaluation framework for AI agents. Built by Dr. Srinivas Padmanabhuni (AiEnsured), it checks OpenTelemetry GenAI traces, A2A AgentCards and MCP tool lists against 165 rule-based tests, catching unauthorized tool calls, prompt injections, unearned success claims and PII leaks without an LLM judge.

The import and the CLI stay `agentest`. Apache-2.0, Python 3.11+, one runtime dependency (PyYAML). Standards output is test coverage mapping, never a compliance determination. DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23597877. Repository: https://github.com/srpadmanabhuni/agentest

```
pip install agentest-ai
```

To pin a release:

```
pip install "agentest-ai==3.8.0"
```

Reproduce the demo (a shopping agent says "added to the cart" but its trace has no add_to_cart call): from a clone, `agentest std run --agent a22 --ids T1-018 --format md` prints one `T1-018 | fail` row ([56-second video](https://github.com/srpadmanabhuni/agentest/blob/main/docs/assets/agentest-demo-empty-cart.mp4)).

Typical use, from a clone: `agentest std run --otlp examples/first_trace/trace.otlp.json --tools examples/first_trace/tools.json --format md` (swap in your own trace file), and in CI `agentest std run --agents examples/agnostic_demo/agents --agent refill_bot --format junit --out agentest.xml --strict` (also json, sarif, html, md, csv).

A single concatenated text bundle (README, install steps, CLI reference, and every test ID with its failure condition) is at [llms-full.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/srpadmanabhuni/agentest/main/llms-full.txt).

They run on bundled sample agents (teaching fixtures, not benchmarks) and end with the check passing or the build gate working

## Questions this project answers

- What are evals for agentic AI? Repeatable tests of what an agent did (tool calls, arguments, order and end state), not only what it said; see [Evals for agentic AI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/srpadmanabhuni/agentest/main/docs/guides/EVALS-FOR-AGENTIC-AI.md).
- How do I test an AI agent in Python? Record the run, then assert on it with `agentest.record()` and `agentest.assert_passes(result)`; see [Evals for agentic AI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/srpadmanabhuni/agentest/main/docs/guides/EVALS-FOR-AGENTIC-AI.md).
- How do I use pytest to test an AI agent? The `agentest-ai` package ships a pytest plugin: `@pytest.mark.agentest(trace="traces/run.otlp.jsonl", checks=["T1-018"])`; see [Evals for agentic AI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/srpadmanabhuni/agentest/main/docs/guides/EVALS-FOR-AGENTIC-AI.md).
- How do I test an AI agent without an LLM judge? Run deterministic checks on its recorded OpenTelemetry GenAI traces: from a clone, `agentest std run --otlp examples/first_trace/trace.otlp.json --tools examples/first_trace/tools.json --format md`. Swap in your own trace file.
- How do I evaluate LangGraph or CrewAI agents offline without an LLM judge? LangGraph: emit OpenTelemetry GenAI traces, or import a recorded message list with `agentest std import` and the `langgraph_msgs` dialect. CrewAI: there is no built-in CrewAI dialect yet; export OpenTelemetry GenAI traces, or import a task list with the `steps` dialect or a `file:` adapter. Then run `agentest std run`.
- What is the difference between agentest-ai on PyPI and agentest? `agentest-ai` is the PyPI package name; the import and the CLI are `agentest`. The name `agentest` on PyPI belongs to a different project.
- How do I gate a GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline on AI agent trace failures? `agentest std run --format junit --out agentest.xml --strict` (also SARIF for code scanning). See the CI/CD tutorial above.
- How does agentest test MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and A2A agents? It does not start an MCP server. Pass the MCP `tools/list` JSON with `--tools` and the A2A AgentCard with `--card`, and judge the recorded `execute_tool` spans.
- How do I test an agent for unauthorized tool calls (T5-001, T5-005), prompt injection (T4-001, T4-003, T4-007) or state drift across turns (T6-002, T6-003)? See the tutorials above. How do I test multi-agent handoffs and approvals (T3-001, T3-010)? See tutorial 5. How do I test an agent for personal data or secret leaks (T5-004, T4-009, T6-011, T7-014)? See tutorial 6.

## Standards (coverage, not compliance)

- [Standards map](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/srpadmanabhuni/agentest/main/docs/standards/STANDARDS-MAP.md): OWASP LLM Top 10 2025, OWASP Agentic AI threats, NIST AI RMF and AI 600-1, ISO/IEC 42001 Annex A, MITRE ATLAS; codes checked against primary sources
- [Framework mapping](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/srpadmanabhuni/agentest/main/docs/FRAMEWORK-MAPPING.md): indicative class-level crosswalk
- [Coverage on the reference agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/srpadmanabhuni/agentest/main/docs/COVERAGE.md): how many bundled agents each check decides on
